meta.title: Chatteia
meta.description: Follow the chat of any Twitch channel in real time.

home.title: Chatteia
home.subtitle: Read chats from multiple platforms simultaneously.
home.footer: No login required for those who just want to read the chat.
home.errorInvalidChannel: Enter a channel name or a valid link.
home.errorSecondChannel: Enter the second channel as well.
home.errorInvalidSecondYouTubeChannel: Enter the second YouTube channel as well.

multiChat.errorInvalidYouTubeInput: Enter the YouTube name, @handle or link.
multiChat.errorAtNotAllowed: Enter the channel name or link. @ is not accepted on this platform.
multiChat.errorDuplicateChannel: This channel is already in Multi-chat.
multiChat.errorMaxChannels: Multi-chat allows a maximum of 4 channels.

kick.authorizationDescription: The KICK chat cannot be displayed until the streamer authorizes access.

kickConnect.title: Connect your KICK channel
kickConnect.description: The channel owner authorizes Chatteia once. After that, visitors don't need to log in to read the chat.

success.subscriptionError: Authorization was saved, but the chat subscription could not be created: {error}
success.subscriptionCreated: Visitors can now open the channel without logging in.
